mapper.sql: p.id, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.brand_id, b.name as brand_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.price_low, p.price_high, p.stock, p.sales, p.rating, p.review_count, p.good_rate, p.status, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time
mapper.select: select , p.detail from mall_product p left join mall_category c on c.id = p.category_id left join mall_brand b on b.id = p.brand_id where p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_product (category_id, brand_id, name, subtitle, main_image, detail, price_low, price_high, stock, sales, rating, status, sort, create_time, update_time) values (#{categoryId}, #{brandId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{detail}, #{priceLow}, #{priceHigh}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{rating}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update mall_product set category_id = #{categoryId}, brand_id = #{brandId}, name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, main_image = #{mainImage}, detail = #{detail}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update mall_product set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}

update mall_product p set p.price_low = coalesce((select min(s.price) from mall_sku s where s.product_id = p.id and s.status = 1), 0), p.price_high = coalesce((select max(s.price) from mall_sku s where s.product_id = p.id and s.status = 1), 0), p.stock = coalesce((select sum(s.stock) from mall_sku s where s.product_id = p.id and s.status = 1), 0), p.update_time = now() where p.id = #{productId}

update mall_product p set p.rating = coalesce((select round(avg(r.rating), 2) from mall_review r where r.product_id = p.id), 5.00), p.review_count = (select count(*) from mall_review r where r.product_id = p.id), p.good_rate = coalesce((select round(sum(case when r.rating >= 4 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) * 100, 2) from mall_review r where r.product_id = p.id), 100.00), p.update_time = now() where p.id = #{productId}
